## About
B & M Auto Collision Center is owned and operated by Bogdan (Bob) Trytko. The shop sits just west of Milwaukee in Old Irving Park, north of Logan Square and south of Albany Park.
We focus on auto body repair, auto body paint and writing estimates, with mechanical work in the same building. Our technicians are I-CAR certified, and we use on-site laser alignment, frame laser measurement and spot welding to bring your car back to pre-accident condition.
We work with all standard insurance companies and can line up a tow and a rental car while your car is with us. We hold a 4.2 rating from 230 Google reviews.

## Services
- Auto body repair: I-CAR certified technicians repair collision damage using on-site laser alignment, frame laser measurement and spot welding.
- Auto body paint: Surface prep, primer, paint and finish coats, applied in full downdraft baking paint booths.
- Mechanical repair: From tune-ups and oil changes to brake and muffler service and engine repair, our mechanics diagnose the problem and fix it.
- Free estimates: Our estimators work to make sure the estimate reflects the actual cost of the repair. Make an appointment at your convenience.
- Towing: We teamed up with A AllStar Towing so you can get a tow to our shop at any hour, any day of the week.
- Rental cars: We arrange a rental through Enterprise Rent-A-Car, and they pick you up when you drop off your car.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: We work with all standard insurance companies. We also review the estimate your insurer provides to make sure nothing was overlooked.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We are on W Addison St, just west of Milwaukee in Old Irving Park, north of Logan Square and south of Albany Park.
